rows.label: CLEFT
rows.clue: A split or indentation in something (as the palate or chin)

rows.label: RECTANGLE
rows.clue: A parallelogram with four right angles

rows.label: DROOP
rows.clue: A shape that sags

rows.label: CRESCENT
rows.clue: Any shape resembling the curved shape of the moon in its first or last quarters

rows.label: SCROLL
rows.clue: A round shape formed by a series of concentric circles (as formed by leaves or flower petals)

rows.label: BELL SHAPE
rows.clue: The shape of a bell

rows.label: CREASE
rows.clue: An angular or rounded shape made by folding

rows.label: OCTAGON
rows.clue: An eight-sided polygon

rows.label: MOGUL
rows.clue: A bump on a ski slope

rows.label: BOUND
rows.clue: A line determining the limits of an area

rows.label: PRISM
rows.clue: A polyhedron with two congruent and parallel faces (the bases) and whose lateral faces are parallelograms

rows.label: CIRCLE
rows.clue: Ellipse in which the two axes are of equal length

rows.label: BOTTLENECK
rows.clue: A narrowing that reduces the flow through a channel

rows.label: ACUTE ANGLE
rows.clue: An angle less than 90 degrees but more than 0 degrees

rows.label: PORE
rows.clue: Any tiny hole admitting passage of a liquid (fluid or gas)

rows.label: SOLID ANGLE
rows.clue: An angle formed by three or more planes intersecting at a common point (the vertex)

rows.label: WAVE ANGLE
rows.clue: The angle of arrival (or departure) of a radio wave with respect to the axis of an antenna array

rows.label: OVOID
rows.clue: An egg-shaped object

rows.label: BLOB
rows.clue: An indistinct shapeless form

rows.label: WASHOUT
rows.clue: The channel or break produced by erosion of relatively soft soil by water

rows.label: SCOTCH
rows.clue: A slight surface cut (especially a notch that is made to keep a tally)

rows.label: TORUS
rows.clue: A ring-shaped surface generated by rotating a circle around an axis that does not intersect the circle

rows.label: PERVERSION
rows.clue: A curve that reverses the direction of something

rows.label: ZIGZAG
rows.clue: An angular shape characterized by sharp turns in alternating directions

rows.label: FORKING
rows.clue: The place where something divides into branches

rows.label: CURVE
rows.clue: The trace of a point whose direction of motion changes

rows.label: RHOMBOID
rows.clue: A parallelogram with adjacent sides of unequal lengths

rows.label: POLYGON
rows.clue: A closed plane figure bounded by straight sides

rows.label: EQUIPOISE
rows.clue: Equality of distribution
